section_header: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering
title: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering

content.description: Diagram showing the intermediate shaft assembly with labels (a), (b), and (c) pointing to different components. Shows a steering column shaft with universal joint connections at both ends.

items: (b) Remove the rack housing side first.

content.description: Diagram showing steering wheel with pad and retaining screw location at lower portion of steering wheel pad

items: (a) Remove the screw at the lower portion of the steering wheel pad and pull the pad out upward.

content.description: Diagram showing steering wheel with SST (Special Service Tool) being used to remove steering wheel

items: (c) Using SST, remove the steering wheel. SST 09609-20011
REMOVE INSTRUMENT LOWER PANEL AND AIR DUCT
REMOVE COLUMN COVER AND COMBINATION SWITCH

content.description: Diagram showing column hole cover plate with two mounting bolts to be removed

items: REMOVE TWO MOUNTING BOLTS FROM COLUMN HOLE COVER PLATE
REMOVE TWO COLUMN BRACKET MOUNTING NUTS

content.description: Diagram showing column tube and shaft assembly being pulled out with turning motion indicated

items: PULL OUT COLUMN TUBE AND SHAFT

content.text: Turn the column tube as shown and pull out the shaft.
